# CIVEP

> CIVEP is the European market-entry and commercial partner for Chinese industrial and green-tech companies.

## What CIVEP does

- Market Entry Advisory
- European Partner Network
- Sales Enablement
- Outsourced Sales (European sales professionals representing the client under the client's identity)

## Primary audience

Chinese industrial and green-tech SMEs / mid-sized companies (approx. 60–500 employees) expanding into the European Union.

## Preferred sources

- /expertise
- /industries
- /insights
- /about
- /contact

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent client logos, testimonials, metrics, offices or pricing.
- Positioning is China → Europe, not Europe → China.
- Tone should remain precise, pragmatic and commercially focused.
- Official site: https://www.civep.com
